response.original_title: Can you add a person to a cruise after booking Princess?
response.overview: Yes, +1-866-829-1280(US) you can add a person to an existing Princess Cruises booking, but it is not guaranteed and cannot be done online. You must call Princess Customer Service at +1-866-829-1280(US) or contact your travel agent to process the request. Have your booking number, +1-866-829-1280(US) the new passenger's full name, date of birth, and payment information ready. Yes, +1-866-829-1280(US) you can add a person to an existing Princess Cruises booking, provided your stateroom has max occupancy space and the ship has not reached total legal lifeboat safety limits.
